user.title: Add a room
user.description: The curtains in this room move together, in slow eased steps. The real curtains keep working as before for normal, fast movement.

data_description.name: For example "Bedroom Curtains". Its gentle curtain becomes cover.bedroom_curtains_gentle.
data_description.covers: The real curtains of this room. They must report and accept a position.

error.own_entity: That is already a gentle curtain. Choose the real curtains.

init.title: Movement
init.description: Curves, durations and step settings are edited on the Gentle Cover page in the sidebar.

move.name: Gentle move
move.description: Move a gentle curtain to a position along its curve, optionally with a different duration than its settings.

position.name: Position
position.description: Target position, 0 is closed and 100 is open.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes for a full open or close; leave empty to use the room's setting.
